info.prompt: Ultrawide shot of a cybernetic dice pit mid-rotation, tiles shearing away in 400ms physics settle under the glow of a gothic gold filigree framework, hidden pocket slot burning molten with a stashed die while the HUD flickers between red PRESSURE and green SLIPSTREAM indicators, trailing players' speed lines streaking across the grid as leaders ripple with heat distortion, all watched over by a skeletal clockwork angel whose wings are made of oscilloscope tracings.
